description: This PHP class ContentType extends another class and defines a method to create a converter object with specific configuration, for handling Markdown content types in an HTML formatting context.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: A class extending the base Markdown ContentType to create a specific converter with configuration.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CommonMarkConverter instance configured with the 'daux' option set to the class's configuration.
